parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The device's ID on the gateway, 24 hexadecimal digits. Filled in by discovery.

parameter.name: wateringDuration
parameter.label: Watering Duration
parameter.description: How long a valve stays open when switched ON, in minutes, until its Watering Duration channel is set to something else. The device closes the valve by itself when the time is up.
